newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone threatens ships and NW Australia coast-WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone threatens ships and NW Australia coast-WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone 27s is tracking towards the northwest coast of Australia and continues to impact shipping with top winds of 50 mph, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
This system will threaten Barrow Island and the coastline between Onslow and Dampier later on Friday. Top winds could be near 55-60 mph at that time.
Rough seas and winds will cause some damage through coastal property during this period. The oil rigs in the region will also be affected by this system, WSC said.
